title: rapid-afternoon-standup-console-tooling-2026-03-26
content:
Afternoon quick sync notes — short, informal. Trying to capture action items from the 15-min standup + follow-ups.

Attendees: Priya (owner), Ellen, Samir, Kai, Marina (handed off at 14:30).
Time: 2026-03-26 14:00–14:20 PT (lightning format).
Context: sprint 24, mid-sprint canary for route-based UI rollout + analytics instrumentation sweep after last week's incidents.

Agenda (quick):
- UI: two small layout regressions reported in /routes/new-config, prioritize fixes.
- Rollouts: canary ramp status and rollback criteria check.
- Analytics: missing events in last 6 hours for A/B cohort B.
- Blockers and short-term capacity.

Notes:
1) UI: layout regressions
- Report: left nav overlap on 1366x768 when user opens model details modal. Reported by CS (ticket ROLL-78). Repro steps in the ticket.
- Root cause hypothesis: CSS cascade change from recent tokenization of header styles (PR 412) — likely specific z-index and padding on Modal shell.
- Quick mitigation: push small patch to override z-index for modal in legacy breakpoint. Patch drafted by Ellen (branch: hotfix/modal-z).
- Acceptance criteria: pass visual diff on the three canonical breakpoints, no regressions on mobile.
- Risks: the override may hide other intented sticky header behavior. Test matrix assigned to Kai.

2) Rollouts: canary ramp
- Current status: canary at 18% of traffic (scheduled ramping: 5% -> 25% over 48h).
- Observed: slight uptick in 95th percentile latency (~30ms increase) for requests that hit the new route renderer. Baseline: 120ms -> now 150ms p95 on eu-west region.
- Hypothesis: additional client-side rendering work + extra telemetry payload appended by analytics instrumentation.
- Decision: pause ramp at 18% while investigation continues. Samir will open a short investigation runbook and start narrowing down whether latency is server-side or client-side.
- Rollback criteria (agreed): if p95 latency > 200ms OR error rate (5xx) increases by >0.3% over baseline in a 15-min window, automatically rollback to previous variant. These thresholds added to canary policy in the rollout service.

3) Analytics: missing events / A/B cohort B
- Problem: cohort B missing event: console.route_opened on ~10% of sessions. Cause unknown.
- Immediate triage: Kai to verify client SDK version delivered to cohort B and whether event wiring was gated behind a feature flag introduced in PR 387.
- Temporary mitigation: add server-side synthetic event for cohort B when route_opened is absent for session within first 30s, to avoid gaps in downstream metrics. Marina to coordinate with data team (ticket referenced in linked_artifacts).
- Danger: synthetic events could skew upstream funnel metrics if not flagged. Add synthetic_event=true tag to synthetic events for later filtering.

4) Incident follow-ups and telemetry hygiene
- Action: add a health check in the rollout proxy that checks both header propagation and event flush size. Samir will prototype the probe by EOD Monday.
- Add a dashboard tile: "canary route p95 vs baseline" with sentinel alert if delta > 25ms over 10m window. Priya to file the dashboard PR.

5) Short items / misc
- UX tweak: reduce spacing of model-version pill in header; low risk, Ellen to ship along with modal z-index patch.
- Docs: update rollout runbook with current rollback thresholds and who to call (on-call SRE + product owner). Priya to update Confluence.
- Perf test: run controlled traffic test for the new renderer at 1k req/s to validate p95 behavior. Ben (perf infra) volunteered to help next Tuesday.

Action items (owner -> due):
- Ellen: finish hotfix/modal-z branch, open PR with visual diffs -> due 2026-03-26 EOD.
- Kai: run targeted visual and cross-breakpoint tests for modal change -> due 2026-03-27 morning.
- Samir: investigate latency uplift, produce investigation runbook and prototype health probe -> due 2026-03-29.
- Marina: coordinate synthetic event gating and ensure synthetic_event tagging with data team -> due 2026-03-27.
- Priya: add canary p95 dashboard tile + update runbook with rollback criteria -> due 2026-03-28.
- Ben (perf): schedule controlled load test for renderer (depending on Samir) -> tentative 2026-03-31.

Blockers:
- Need confirmation from infra on whether the added telemetry size could trigger downstream proxy limits (limit testing ticket created, waiting for infra ops).
- Access: Kai needs temporary elevated access to the analytics ingestion sandbox to replay missing events (access request in progress).

Open questions / notes to self:
- If we add synthetic events, how do we ensure downstream automated alerts (funnel drops) exclude them? Need filter mapping in the metrics pipeline.
- Evaluate whether client SDK should compress telemetry payloads when feature flag toggles are enabled for canary cohorts.
- Could the CSS change have been avoided by using a context-aware z-index scale? Note for design system PR review checklist.

Decisions made in this short sync:
- Pause canary at 18% until latency root cause is identified.
- Add synthetic event tagging and coordinate with data team before moving forward.
- Aggressively test modal fix across breakpoints before promoting change to canary.

Quick retrospective note (informal):
- The last two rollouts have shown that small client-side telemetry additions are easy to overlook and can have measurable perf effects. Need a small pre-rollout checklist item: "does this change alter telemetry payload size or event frequency?". Add to rollout checklist.

Next sync: quick follow-up tomorrow 10:30 PT if there are updates from Samir or Kai; otherwise next scheduled standup on Friday.

---
This is intentionally terse — serve as a lightweight log for the team. Keep this doc as the short-lived working copy; will move important items into Confluence/Runbook and Jira tickets as resolved.
